newsitem.title: USA: ACI Q3 loss despite increased capacity.
newsitem.headline: ACI Q3 loss despite increased capacity.

text.p: ACI Telecentrics Inc said Tuesday increased production capacity failed to prevent a net loss in the third quarter.

Earlier, the company reported a proforma net loss of $131,745 or $0.03 per share compared to a proforma net profit of $25,343 or $0.01 per share in 1995. Third quarter revenues rose to $2.16 million compared to $1.32 million last year.

"(D)emand for outbound telemarketing services typically decreases in the third quarter as clients tend to cut back on telemarketing projects," said Rick Diamond, ACI's chief executive officer, adding the fluctuations in workload caused ACI's telemarketing centers to operate less efficiently.

In addition, Diamond said selling, general and administrative expenses increased as the company added personnel in sales and administrative areas, gearing up for its initial public offering last month and for its 1997 programs.
